verdict: Paid channels remain offline; your Google Business profile is the only active signal.
narrative: This period, no spend ran on Meta or Google Ads — zero clicks, zero leads, zero cost across both channels. Your Google Business Profile was the one live source of activity, generating 107 impressions and 59 direction requests over 28 days, but zero calls came through despite that visibility, pointing to a broken or missing click-to-call link on your profile that we are fixing now. Your website drew 602 sessions this period, but no conversions were recorded, and 4 new contacts entered the CRM with 2 opportunities opened and none closed. Resolving the profile call issue and bringing paid channels back online are the immediate priorities heading into the next period.
